modelApi.title: API Usage
modelApi.description: Replace YOUR_API_KEY with a One API token. Requests follow your token's channel routing. Model availability and optional parameters depend on the configured provider.
modelApi.illustrative: Illustrative, shortened responses only. IDs, generated content, token usage and embedding dimensions vary.

notes.upload: Replace audio.wav or image.png with a local file supported by the model. curl sets the multipart boundary automatically.
notes.video: Video generation is asynchronous. Use the returned ID with GET /v1/videos/{video_id} to check status and GET /v1/videos/{video_id}/content to retrieve the result.
notes.realtime: This curl example verifies only the WebSocket upgrade and stops after 10 seconds. Use a WebSocket client to exchange realtime events; curl does not run a full conversation.
notes.voice: The audio response is saved to speech.wav. Replace YOUR_VOICE_ID, when present, with a voice supported by the model.
notes.document: Replace the example document URL with an accessible document URL or an input supported by this provider.
notes.clone: Replace YOUR_AUDIO_FILE_ID with a provider reference-audio file ID and text with its exact transcript. The returned voice ID can be used for speech synthesis.
notes.systemone: Jev is a typed evaluation model, not a chat model. Use state and questions (noul, choice, or score); chat formats and streaming are unsupported. The response contains answers and input_tokens/output_tokens, and model reports the resolved version. Values below are illustrative.
notes.geminiLive: This curl command checks only the HTTP upgrade. To run a Gemini Live session, use a WebSocket client, send the native setup message first and wait for setupComplete before input. OpenAI session.update events are not interchangeable. No conversation or model inference is tested by this handshake.
notes.diarization: Replace audio.wav with your recording. diarized_json returns speaker-labeled segments; chunking_strategy=auto also handles recordings longer than 30 seconds.
notes.jinaOcr: Replace document.png with an accessible document image or a supported image data URL. Jina OCR uses Chat Completions to read images and return Markdown; this is not a general text-chat example.
notes.legacy: This is a legacy Completions contract. Model retirement and provider endpoint settings can make old catalog entries unavailable; confirm support before calling.
notes.grokVideo: Use the xAI channel with Videos enabled. Supply duration explicitly (1–15 seconds); resolution defaults to 480p. Input images are billed separately. Replace YOUR_REQUEST_ID with the returned request_id and poll every few seconds while status is pending; stop on done, failed or expired. Read video.url when done and save the temporary URL promptly. There is no /content endpoint.

modelApi.contractScope: These are gateway protocol templates, not live availability tests. Confirm the mapped model, enabled channel endpoint and provider requirements before calling. Responses show representative fields, not complete schemas.

unverified.title: No verified gateway example
unverified.unknown: The catalog does not identify a reviewed request/response contract for this model. Modalities and prices do not establish an API. Ask the administrator to verify the mapped model and channel endpoint; no chat request is assumed.
unverified.native: This model needs a provider-specific protocol that is not covered by a verified gateway example here. Consult the reference and confirm the adaptor and endpoint configuration rather than using a generic chat or media request.
